_note: Left_hand_link_base in p2d2.urdf -- bolted rigidly to the MOAT, so no hand joint moves it. It is the root of the tracked chain: the largest plate, so the widest marker spread, so the best-constrained orientation, and orientation is the only thing a revolute projection consumes.
_unchecked: Nothing upstream measures this body, so its error is common mode -- it shifts theta8 and theta9 together rather than showing in either residual. The toolpoint comparison against the robot is what catches it, once the bridge publishes.

_placement_when_the_bridge_exists._note: The robot's own claim about this plate, from its forward kinematics. Rail-relative, on the same clock as the mocap stamps. The only check on the tracked chain's root.

calibrated.note: Pivot set by hand at a CAD point -- which is the whole mount calibration, since there is no offset field to correct it. Verified by inter-pivot distances agreeing with CAD to under 1 mm.
